title: Draft content loss on rapid suggestion dismiss
description: In rare cases, rapidly dismissing a suggestion while the compose window is auto-saving can cause the draft body to be overwritten with an empty string. Reproduced on Android 13 / Pixel 7 and iOS 17. Root cause: race condition between suggestion overlay teardown and draft auto-save debounce timer.
workaround: Manually save draft before dismissing suggestions.

title: Elevated p95 latency at >10% rollout
description: Inference API p95 latency exceeds 300 ms target when rollout crosses 10% of user base. Likely caused by model-serving cold starts under bursty traffic. Horizontal auto-scaling policy may be too conservative.
workaround: Pre-warm inference pods before expanding rollout cohort.

title: Suggestions use contact names from unrelated threads
description: The context window sent to the model occasionally includes metadata from adjacent threads in the mailbox, causing the suggestion to reference names / subjects not in the current conversation. This is a context-boundary bug in the payload builder, not a data leak — no email body content crosses threads.
workaround: Dismiss incorrect suggestions; they do not affect sent content.

title: No user-facing toggle to disable Smart Compose
description: v4.12.0 ships without a user-visible setting to disable Smart Compose. The internal feature flag can be toggled by support, but this requires a ticket. A user-facing toggle is planned for v4.12.1 (ETA: Day 14).
workaround: Users can contact support to disable via feature flag.

title: Suggestion overlay flickers on low-end Android devices
description: On devices with < 4 GB RAM, the ghost-text overlay occasionally flickers during rapid typing. Cosmetic only — no functional impact.
